description.ja: 人とAIの“すれ違い”をテーマに挑む新規SFプロジェクト『SYNDUALITY』が本格始動！
description.en: A new science fiction project “SYNDUALITY” that challenges the theme of “passing each other” between humans and AI has started in earnest!

description.ja: 2023年放送開始予定のTVアニメ『SYNDUALITY』から、謎の男“黒仮面”が搭乗する「ギルボウ」が特徴的な武装や多彩なギミックを搭載し、HGシリーズで最速立体化！
description.en: From the TV anime "SYNDUALITY " scheduled to start broadcasting in 2023, " Gilbow " piloted by the mysterious man " Black Mask" is equipped with distinctive weapons and various gimmicks, and is the fastest in the HG series to become three-dimensional!

description.ja: ■細部までディテールを造形されたコックピットとコフィンはスライド・オープンギミックを搭載。黒仮面とシュネーのフィギュアが付属し搭乗状態を再現できる。
description.en: • The cockpit and coffin are sculpted with great detail and are equipped with a slide/open gimmick. Black mask and Schnee figures are included, allowing you to recreate the riding state.

description.ja: ■腕部の「エネルギー・インパクト・ブレード」と「ミサイルポッド」は展開が可能。
description.en: • The "Energy Impact Blade " and " Missile Pod" on the arm can be expanded.

description.ja: ■特徴的な脚部には複数の可動軸を内蔵。劇中のホバー状態を再現できる脚部形態変形用パーツも付属。
description.en: • The unique legs have multiple movable axes. Parts for changing the shape of the legs are also included to recreate the hover state from the movie.

description.ja: ■ディスプレイ台座が付属しアクションポーズをサポート。
description.en: • A display pedestal is included to support action poses.

description.ja: ■印象的なマーキングを再現できるシールが付属。
description.en: • Comes with a seal that can reproduce impressive markings.

accessories.ja: 脚部形態変形用パーツ×1式
accessories.en: Leg shape transformation parts x 1 set

accessories.ja: フィギュア×２種(黒仮面、シュネー)
